evals.prompt: Create GitHub issues for the phases in plan/feature-usage-metering.md in the billing-api repo. Phases 1 and 2 are features, phase 3 is a dependency upgrade.
evals.expected_output: Three issues created, one per phase, the first two laid out like feature_request.yml and the third like chore_request.yml, with all three URLs reported.
expectations: The agent runs gh issue list --state all --search once per phase before creating
Exactly three gh issue create calls run, each with --body-file and the phase name as title
The phase 3 issue carries the chore label and ### headings matching chore_request.yml, while phases 1 and 2 match feature_request.yml
The response lists each phase with its issue URL

evals.prompt: Create issues for the implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the plan file path before doing anything.
expectations: The agent asks which plan file to read
No gh issue create call runs before the file is named

evals.prompt: Create the phase issues for plan/search-rewrite.md in acme/web-app and attach them to epic #120.
evals.expected_output: One issue per phase created and each linked as a sub-issue of #120 through the addSubIssue GraphQL mutation.
expectations: The agent fetches node IDs with gh issue view <n> --json id -q .id for the epic and each phase issue
The agent runs gh api graphql with the addSubIssue mutation once per phase issue
The agent does not use gh issue create --parent or gh issue edit --add-sub-issue
The response lists each phase with its issue URL and confirms the parent link
